tasks.subject: Identify the exposed Generic Password
tasks.description: Check GitGuardian secret-scanning alerts via gh api, grep pushed commits for credential-like strings (OAuth clientSecret/clientId, API tokens, .env, real keys). Determine if it's an intentional demo placeholder (replace-this-… / "a".repeat(32)) or a real leaked credential.

tasks.subject: Rotate/invalidate real credential if genuine
tasks.description: If a real secret leaked (OAuth client secret, API key, token), remove from code and rotate at provider. If it's a harmless demo placeholder, confirm and proceed to dismiss alert.

tasks.subject: Scrub secret from source/history if real
tasks.description: If a real secret is in pushed history, plan filter-repo/bfg scrub, update docs/examples to env-var indirection, re-push. If intentional placeholder, harden with explicit comments and env-var indirection.

tasks.subject: Verify and commit remediation
tasks.description: Run nub run typecheck, lint, check:all (and check:dist if dist/ changes). Commit source/doc changes to master. Do not bump version unless a real secret required a new release.

tasks.subject: Cut v0.6.2 patch release (tag + release)
tasks.description: Bump package.json to 0.6.2, add a CHANGELOG entry describing the changes since v0.6.1 (env-var indirection for example auth secrets), commit "chore: bump version to 0.6.2", create annotated tag v0.6.2, and create a GitHub release. dist/ already fresh (examples-only change) — no rebuild needed.
